definitions: A set of communication protocols that enable two electronic devices, one of which is typically a portable device like a smartphone, to establish communication by bringing them within 4 cm (1.6 in) of each other.
A technology that allows for contactless data exchange and transactions over short distances.
examples: Many modern smartphones include NFC capabilities.
You can use NFC for mobile payments.
The new card supports NFC for quick tap-and-go transactions.
